heading: Join StatSoc
subheading: Become a StatSoc member through the University of Sydney Union (USU). Membership is free and only takes a few minutes!
heroContinuation: Follow the guide below and you’ll be part of our community in just a few steps.
videoTitle: How to join StatSoc through USU

steps.title: Visit the USU website
steps.imageAlt: Illustration of a student opening the USU website on a laptop
steps.body: Go to usu.edu.au and select the account icon in the top-right corner, then choose Login.

steps.title: Log in to your USU account
steps.imageAlt: Illustration of signing in to a student account using a verification code
steps.body: Enter your mobile number or USU member ID, then verify your identity with the code sent to you. New to USU? Choose Join USU to register first.

steps.title: Access the Clubs platform
steps.imageAlt: Illustration of navigating from the USU site to its clubs platform
steps.body: Open the Clubs section and select Proceed to MyUSU. You will be redirected to the USU clubs platform.

steps.title: Find StatSoc
steps.imageAlt: Illustration of searching for The University of Sydney Statistics Society
steps.body: Open Groups and search for “The University of Sydney Statistics Society”. Select StatSoc in the results to open our society profile.

steps.title: Join the society
steps.imageAlt: Illustration of choosing a membership option and joining a student society
steps.body: On the StatSoc profile, click Join Group. Choose the available membership option from the dropdown, then click Join to continue.

steps.title: Confirm your membership
steps.imageAlt: Illustration showing a successful membership confirmation
steps.body: Follow the prompts to confirm your details and complete registration. When you see “Thanks for joining!”, you are officially a StatSoc member!
